blockingFindings.description: Direct sit and crouch renders show the front apron still displaced behind the lap; fitted shorts remain exposed across the seated thighs. The pose-matched diagnostic measures overskirt upper-thigh coverage at 30.8% left / 28.8% right in sit and 40.5% / 40.2% in crouch, while shorts cover 95.5% / 95.4%. The v20 front-panel extension/projection improved these readings only modestly and did not retain front lap drape.

Neutral, turntable and pose views still show irregular coarse/faceted folds instead of controlled sewn pleats. The added front apron does not form a coherent lap-facing panel in sit; a long triangular side/rear portion hangs behind the bent legs.
The back view still does not clearly reveal an attached rear adjustment tab or buckle; the feature remains low-contrast and nearly flush with the waist/skirt seam.
Jacket seam trim and elbow quilting remain faint against the mostly plain ivory surface, and the outfit still lacks the intended fencing-set detail definition.
No authored UV layout exists for the current weighted garment mesh; UV status remains NOT_CREATED.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
